t: Ready to use white construction adhesive based on acrylic dispersions, adheres to most common building surfaces and replaces nails and screws. Will adhere to masonry, concrete, plaster, chipboard and wood. Fixes PVCu extrusions, skirting boards, thresholds, lightweight coving and ceiling panels, architraves, dado rails and ceramic tiles, as well as carpet gripper systems and stair nosings. Secures aluminium and other skin panels to framework. One surface must be porous. For internal use only.
b: Can be Used on Damp Surfaces
